label: Ukuqasha-ukuze-uthenge
agreementCount: {count, plural, one {# isivumelwano} other {# izivumelwano}} sisonke
noAgreementsDesc: Phequlula izinto ezifakwe ngokuqasha-ukuze-uthenge ukuze uqale.
disclosureFirst: Ukuba nento akufani nokuba ngumnikazi wayo. Uthatha into lapho umthengisi eyidlulisela futhi uqinisekisa ukuyithola — umthengisi uhlala engumnikazi kuze kube yilapho inani lonke lokuqasha-ukuze-uthenge likhokhiwe futhi isikhathi esifushane sokuphothulwa sidlule ngemva kokuba uyithola.
disclosureDefault: Uma lesi sivumelwano sehluleka ngokusemthethweni ngemva kokuba usuthathe into, indlela yokuthenga iyaphela futhi kudingeka ukuthi into ibuyiselwe. I-Unity ikhokhisa izinga lomthengisi lokuqasha/lokusebenzisa ngesikhathi owawunayo ngempela into, kulinganiselwa emalini esesigcinwe — awusoze ukhokhiswe okungaphezu kwaleyo mali esisele igciniwe.
terminated: Indlela yokuthenga ngokuqasha-ukuze-uthenge iphelile — kuxazululwe njengesikhathi sokuqasha/sokusebenzisa ngesikhathi into eyayiphathwa ngempela.
returnRequiredNotice: Kudingeka ukuthi into ibuyiselwe. Uma ingabuyiselwa ngosuku olwavunyelwana ngalo, idiphozithi yesibambiso iyalahleka.
evidenceRequiredMerchant: Layisha okungenani isithombe/ividiyo eyodwa yesimo sento ngaphambi kokuphawula lesi sivumelwano njengesidluliselwe.
evidenceRequiredCustomer: Layisha okungenani isithombe/ividiyo eyodwa yesimo sento ngesikhathi sokuyithola ngaphambi kokuqinisekisa ukuba nayo.
completionWindowNotice: Ubunikazi buyaphothulwa ngokuzenzakalela uma isikhathi sokuphothulwa sesidlulile ngaphandle kwengxabano engaxazululiwe.
terminationPending: Kuphakanyiswe ukuqedwa ngemvume yomabili amaqembu — kulindwe impendulo yomunye umuntu
initiateDefaultWarning: Lokhu kuhlala njalo. Uma usuqalisa isimo sokwehluleka ngokusemthethweni, ngeke kubuyiselwe emuva noma kulungiswe.
requestSentDesc: Isicelo sakho sithunyelwe kumthengisi. Lokhu akubambeli into futhi akuqedi nkokhelo — uzokwaziswa uma umthengisi esephendule.
reviewTermsDesc: Le yimigomo yomthengisi yale nto. Yibuyekeze ngokucophelela ngaphambi kokucela.
disclosurePossession: Ukuba nento akufani nobunikazi bayo — uthatha into lapho umthengisi eyidlulisela futhi uqinisekisa ukuyithola.
disclosureOwnership: Umthengisi uhlala engumnikazi kuze kube yilapho inani lonke likhokhiwe, wathola into, futhi isikhathi esifushane sokuphothulwa ngaphandle kwengxabano sidlulile.
disclosureEscrow: Izavenga zigcinwa (zilawulwa ngomgcini-mali) kuze kube yilapho isivumelwano siphothulwa ngempumelelo noma sixazululwe ngemva kokwehluleka — azikhokhelwa umthengisi ngokushesha.
rtbSectionDesc: Le nto iyatholakala nangendlela yokuqasha-ukuze-uthenge — khokha ngezavenga bese uba ngumnikazi uma isikhokhiwe ngokugcwele.
committedToRentToBuyDesc: Le nto igciniwe njengamanje ngaphansi kwesivumelwano esisebenzayo sokuqasha-ukuze-uthenge.
